Thank you very much for answering our questions about the current situation of your company. We now have one further request.

In addition to the current situation of the surveyed companies, we would like to include developments from past years in later analyses. To take these factors into account, we would like to use statistical indicators for some analyses that are available for your company at the IAB, the Institute of Employment Research of the Federal Employment Agency. These indicators are based on the social security reports that your company submits annually for its employees.
